## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`; see "Sign your commits" in CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated with the change
- [ ] ADR updated in docs/adr if a contract changed
- [ ] Generated files (`docs/reference/attributes.*`, `docs/generated/*.md`) regenerated, not edited by hand
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed
